title: Discovery Manifest
description: Release-time scan output for @event4u/agent-config. See ADR-013 and agents/roadmaps/archive/automated-pack-workspace-and-skill-discovery.md (archived, status: completed).

version.description: Manifest schema version. Bump on breaking change. v2 (road-to-tier-removal Phase 1 / ADR-092) added the top-level `deprecations` block while the integer command `tier` field stayed emitted; v3 (Phase 4) DROPS `tier` from command artefacts — a breaking change for any consumer reading the integer, which is why the version carries it.

deprecations.description: road-to-tier-removal Phase 1 / ADR-092 — machine-readable deprecation signals. An entry announces a key still emitted but scheduled for removal, and is RETAINED after removal with `removed_in` set, so a consumer reading a dropped key can still find its replacement.

generated_at.description: UTC ISO-8601 timestamp; the only field allowed to differ between determinism runs.

checksum.description: sha256 of the JSON file with the checksum field zeroed out.

unassigned.description: Artefacts that failed assignment. Each entry MUST carry a reason.

documented_unassigned.description: Artefacts explicitly skipped via src/config/discovery/unassigned-artefacts.yml. Each entry MUST carry a reason.

deprecation.description: A single deprecated manifest key — either still emitted during its soak window, or already removed (then `removed_in` names the manifest version that dropped it). The entry outlives the key on purpose: a consumer still reading the old name needs to learn what replaced it.

scope.description: Where the key appeared (e.g. `command` artefact entries).

replacement.description: The canonical key consumers should read instead (e.g. `visibility`).

since.description: The decision that deprecated it (e.g. an ADR id).

sunset.description: Maintainer-owned removal date/marker; null until the soak window clears (scope-control: agents do not pin dates).

removed_in.description: The manifest `version` in which the key stopped being emitted. Absent while the key is still emitted.

requires.description: capability-packs.md — hard dependency graph (transitive, acyclic). Supersedes requires_hint.

requires_hint.description: Deprecated alias of `requires`, emitted during the deprecation window.

domain.description: capability-packs.md — single primary vertical. Required for in-use packs.

size_class.description: capability-packs.md — per-pack visible-command budget input. Required for in-use packs.

always_on.description: capability-packs.md — default pack the resolver includes in every projection regardless of profile/workspace.

human_review_required.description: Phase 5 (ADR-018) — count of artefacts in this pack with trust.human_review_required=true. Zero for core-only packs.

trust_summary.description: Phase 5 (ADR-018) — per-pack artefact counts broken down by trust level. Sum equals artefact_count.

path.description: POSIX path relative to repo root.

pack.description: capability-packs.md — canonical OWNER pack (ownership/budget unit). Orthogonal to `packs` (discovery tags); the owner need not appear in `packs`.

visibility.description: ADR-090 — named command-surface visibility on `category: command` artefacts; the sole classifier since manifest v3 dropped the integer `tier` alias (road-to-tier-removal Phase 4). Former mapping, for consumers migrating off `tier`: 0↔visible, 1↔advanced, 2↔internal.

intent.description: 6.0.0-C — command routing metadata (one-line existence justification). Present on visible command artefacts.

routes_to.description: 6.0.0-C — command routing metadata (skill/cluster-sub/command slugs the intent routes to).

replaces.description: 6.0.0-C — command routing metadata (prior names/aliases this command absorbs; may be empty).

slug.description: 6.0.0-D — canonical path-derived invocation slug (ADR-044; pack-stripped subpath + opt-in slug_prefix). Distinct from `name` (display, may still be colon for renames deferred to 6.1). The identity `commands ls --profile` matches on.

workspaces.description: Non-empty for skill/rule/command/template (enforced by build_discovery_manifest._classify). ADR-109 subagents legitimately carry [] — default-off, opt-in-by-name, never pack/workspace-scoped.

packs.description: Non-empty for skill/rule/command/template (enforced by build_discovery_manifest._classify). ADR-109 subagents legitimately carry [] — recommended for no pack; included only via include: ["subagent:<name>"].

requires.description: Optional dependency edges — pack IDs the artefact transitively needs at install time. Closed vocabulary.

checksum.description: sha256 of the artefact file content with frontmatter normalized (sorted keys, no trailing whitespace, trailing newline). Drift-detection for the Phase-3 installer.

stats.description: Aggregate counts over the manifest. Cheap sanity surface for `task discovery-stats` and downstream dashboards.
